decision: reproduction run (4 of cap 4, all rc 0, none aborted): REJECTED by the registered rule. The unmodified HL5MN1 fit gives 16 spikes at 100 pA (Allen 14, repeat band 12-14) and 30 at 150 pA (Allen 34): both counts differ by more than 1. The dt pair agrees on both counts (numerics converged for the count); first spikes 26.97 and 16.04 ms after onset against 24.16 and 13.0 ms, pair limits 0.134 and 0.113 ms. The donor stays in the population as type-matched with these labels.
